title: The explicit total-cone cochain isomorphism
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with binary biproducts, and coproducts in the universes of I and Nat. For D,E:I→CochainComplex(A,Int) and φ:D→E, the signed degreewise comparison [def-sc-preorder-bar-total-cone] forms an actual cochain-complex isomorphism from the total bar of the objectwise cone to the cone of the induced arrow between total bars.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents to coneTotalXIso. Its compatibility field is exactly coneTotalXHom_comm. Thus its object data comes from the explicit mutually inverse degreewise maps, and its proof field comes from the proved differential identity.
